info.description: Retrieve Resource Value Unit (RVU) metrics count.
info.title: Resource Metrics

parameters.description: Limits the metrics calculations to metric updated after the specified time. The date and time is in ISO 8601 format, e.g 2022-06-01 10:00:00.000
parameters.name: fromDate

parameters.description: Limits the metrics calculations to metric updated before the specified date. The date and time is in ISO 8601 format, e.g 2022-06-01T10:00:00Z
parameters.name: toDate

500.description: Internal server error. For details, see the server log files.

get.description: Get the resource metrics count numbers.

correlationId.description: The unique identifier for the request.

locale.description: The locale of the error message.

messageArguments.description: The arguments used to construct the error message.

preEnablementOrderLineCount.description: The number order lines using the pre-enablement of HCL Commerce RVU Order Line Metrics calculation.
